response.sql: WITH trans_sentiments AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt, AVG(s.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM transactionrecord t INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals s ON t.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), order_type_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_shortintrt) as order_type_avg_shortintrt FROM trans_sentiments WHERE avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ts.transreg, ts.ordertypedist, ts.avg_shortintrt, ts.avg_optvolrt, CASE WHEN ts.avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND ota.order_type_avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL THEN ts.avg_shortintrt / ota.order_type_avg_shortintrt ELSE NULL END as shortintrt_ratio FROM trans_sentiments ts LEFT JOIN order_type_avg ota ON ts.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist ORDER BY CASE WHEN shortintrt_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, shortintrt_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
